sources.title: 晁補之《雞肋集》卷二十七〈五行說〉四部叢刊系受讀
sources.provider: Wikisource; header reports Shanghai Hanfenlou Ming print facsimile
sources.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/雞肋集_(四部叢刊本)/卷第二十七
sources.quality_notes: Heading and transmitted passage distinguish ten stems and twelve branches, stem/root element vs nayin outcome, criticize exclusive nayin use, explicitly cite Luoluzi, distinguish opposite/same polarity overcoming with Jia-Xin/Yi-Geng vs Jia-Geng/Yi-Xin, and analogize five planets and 28 lodges. Received text only; no specific day-root four-pillar reference, no complete ten-god or Ziwei mechanism, no Ming/Song original glyph.

sources.title: 《濟北晁先生雞肋集》卷二十七〈五行說〉識典國圖系受讀
sources.quality_notes: Lines of received OCR reproduce 甲子 wood versus metal and officer/ghost polarity pairings despite omissions and misrecognitions (e.g. 岡柔). Copy identity and OCR dependency unverified, no independent physical witness or original-glyph adjudication.

sources.title: 《雞肋集》四部叢刊系〈後序〉晁謙之紹興七年署記
sources.provider: Wikisource; header reports Shanghai Hanfenlou Ming print facsimile
sources.quality_notes: Received postface records 28 years after death, compilation to 70 juan and Jianyang printing, signed Shaoxing 7 dingsi eleventh month by Chao Qianzhi. 1137 date belongs to reported paratext and publication event; does not establish extant Song physical copy or composition date of the target essay.

sources.title: 廖咸惠〈閒談、紀實與對話：宋人筆記與術數知識的傳遞〉2018期刊摘要

sources.quality_notes: Vol48 no2 June 2018 pp387–418; first-party abstract discusses literati, specialists, notebooks and circulation of divinatory knowledge. Only abstract and bibliographic metadata read; no ancient rule proof, no independent verification of reported efficacy or exact lineage.
